ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and determine the extent of the issue
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and waste of taxpayer dollars. By following the money and investigating the allegations, we may be able to determine the extent of the issue and who is involved.
